protocol: Full-fit stage: cold ADP_multi_index.fit, isolated fresh process per method/seed, one BLAS thread, perf_counter around fit, process ru_maxrss, no tracing. Capture stage is separately instrumented and excluded from timing aggregates. Frozen stage runs one HPAOResult call per variant/process on captured first-outer statistics and evaluates minimum-norm local-refit profile loss externally.
objective_note: Grassmann/profile methods are compared by common profiled local-refit loss. Current SVD's own fixed-g objective/diagnostics differ; its returned index is re-evaluated using the common profile loss. Full-fit projector recovery is descriptive.
memory_note: ru_maxrss KiB includes interpreter/imports and loaded data; frozen per-process RSS also includes inputs.
